SELECT MAX(FIRE_SIZE) AS max_fire_size
FROM Fires
WHERE STATE = 'AK'
AND FIRE_YEAR IN (2013, 2014, 2015)
AND substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 1, 2) IN ('03','04','05');

SELECT DISCOVERY_DATE, FIRE_YEAR, STATE
FROM Fires
WHERE STATE = 'AK'
AND FIRE_YEAR IN (2013, 2014, 2015)
LIMIT 10;

SELECT MAX(FIRE_SIZE) AS max_fire_size
FROM Fires
WHERE STATE = 'AK'
AND FIRE_YEAR IN (2013, 2014, 2015)
AND (
  (substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 1, 2) = '03' AND CAST(substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) >= 1)
  OR (substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 1, 2) = '04')
  OR (substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 1, 2) = '05' AND CAST(substr(DISCOVERY_DATE, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 31)
);

LIMIT 20;
